name: Partner stuck detection and recovery through the path
body: Replace the retry-then-skip net with: no progress for STUCK_SECONDS re-plans from where she is; a second failure tries the nearest reachable point; only then does she go back to the last safe spot, and only the third time to the beat itself. A beat that has no path says so once (a note) and she goes to the nearest reachable spot rather than pressing into a wall.
